name: Association ELA
verdict: Association Européenne contre les Leucodystrophies: a French nonprofit charity (association déclarée, recognised of public utility since 1996) founded by Guy Alba in 1992; it has no owner above itself. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: nonprofit charity — the owner record is the association itself (a charity has no external owner; DEVK, Bon Secours Mercy Health and Highmark are the precedent for recording mutual/nonprofit bodies as their own owner). Registry nature juridique 9230. No state or fund stake → none. Charity sponsor (front placement beside the commercial sponsors).
